{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg]
    if not pts: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    # find fundamental periods of the colored rectangle
    H=r1-r0+1; W=c1-c0+1
    pr=next((p for p in range(1,H+1) if all(grid[r][c]==grid[r0+(r-r0)%p][c] for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1))),H)
    pc=next((p for p in range(1,W+1) if all(grid[r][c]==grid[r][c0+(c-c0)%p] for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1))),W)
    return [[grid[r0+(r%pr)][c0+((c+1)%pc)] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]"}
